title: poa arctica subsp. stricta
intro: Poa arctica subsp. stricta, commonly known as Arctic bluegrass, is a subspecies of grass native to Arctic tundra regions. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its multiple health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Poa arctica subsp. stricta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
